title: Causal remote test completion: settlement scan latency grows with mailbox history, and its skips leave no readable diagnostic
outcome: A remote runner's passed completion for an original test request settles on the requester promptly regardless of mailbox history size, and an operator can read why a given request has not settled yet.
acceptance: On a requester with a large mailbox_messages and mailbox_relay_intents history, a completed causal test request is read and settled within a bounded time that does not grow with the number of unrelated historical rows, shown by a test with such a history.

For an unsettled original test request, a supported read-only surface reports which settlement stage it is in or which check skipped it (custody or current-plan check, peer handle or lease, relay read timeout, missing or non-authoritative completion, admission target), shown by tests for each stage.
Existing causal admission and federation native binding proof tests stay green.
